title: tripleurospermum melanolepis

It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tripleurospermum melanolepis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic activities.
